tEn: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
tZh: Qwen-UI-Agent 技术报告：迈向下一代以真实世界为中心的基础 GUI 智能体
sEn: Qwen-UI-Agent is a real-world-centric foundation GUI agent that achieves state-of-the-art mobile-use performance and competitive computer/browser-use results through a unified action space, AutoResearch-style data flywheel, and online RL at scale.
sZh: Qwen-UI-Agent 是一个以真实世界为中心的基础 GUI 智能体，通过统一动作空间、AutoResearch 式数据飞轮和大规模在线强化学习，在移动端使用上取得最先进性能，并在电脑和浏览器使用上表现具有竞争力。
absEn: GUI agents have the potential to become a general purpose executor over existing digital devices. To advance them toward real-world use, we envision agents that operate reliably on real devices, execute workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, complete long-horizon tasks, proactively initiate useful services, and autonomously improve their capabilities with minimal human effort. Guided by this vision, we present Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent spanning mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments. Qwen-UI-Agent combines diverse sandbox environments with a large-scale real-device mobile runtime. Its unified action space interleaves GUI operations with CLI execution and generates batched actions in a single model turn. An AutoResearch-style data flywheel uses agents to construct tasks and environments, diagnose failures, and plan subsequent iterations. Online RL supports training on trajectories exceeding 100 turns, with over 10,000 concurrent environments accelerating rollout. A lightweight harness layer supports proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer. Across a broad suite of evaluations, Qwen-UI-Agent sets state-of-the-art performance on mobile-use benchmarks while delivering competitive performance on computer- and browser-use tasks against frontier models, including Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol. On mobile use, it achieves 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, and 97.5% on AndroidDaily. On computer use, it achieves 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified and a 40.0% partial-progress score on OSWorld-v2. On browser use and GUI grounding, it achieves 73.6% on WebArena and 81.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively.
absZh: GUI智能体有潜力成为现有数字设备上的通用执行器。为了推动它们走向实际应用，我们设想智能体能够可靠地在真实设备上运行，跨平台执行工作流，将GUI交互与CLI执行相结合，完成长时程任务，主动发起有用的服务，并以最少的人力自主提升能力。在这一愿景的指导下，我们提出了Qwen-UI-Agent，一个以真实世界为中心的基础GUI智能体，覆盖移动端、电脑使用、网页和DeepSearch环境。Qwen-UI-Agent将多样化的沙盒环境与大规模真实设备移动运行时相结合。其统一动作空间交错执行GUI操作和CLI命令，并在单次模型生成中产生批量动作。一种AutoResearch式数据飞轮利用智能体来构建任务和环境、诊断失败并规划后续迭代。在线强化学习支持对超过100轮的轨迹进行训练，超过10,000个并发环境加速了样本收集。一个轻量级的工程层支持跨移动端和电脑的主动服务发起和有状态工作流。在广泛的评估套件中，Qwen-UI-Agent在移动使用基准上取得了最先进的性能，同时在电脑和浏览器使用任务上与前沿模型（包括Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro和GPT-5.6 Sol）相比表现出有竞争力的性能。在移动使用方面，它在MobileWorld上达到82.1%，在MobileWorld-Real上达到92.2%，在AndroidDaily上达到97.5%。在电脑使用方面，它在OSWorld-Verified上达到79.5%，在OSWorld-v2上获得40.0%的部分进展分数。在浏览器使用和GUI定位方面，它分别在WebArena上达到73.6%，在ScreenSpot-Pro上达到81.5%。

contrib.en: Proposes Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent covering mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments.
contrib.zh: 提出 Qwen-UI-Agent，一种以真实世界为中心的基础 GUI 智能体，覆盖移动端、电脑使用、网页和 DeepSearch 环境。

contrib.en: Unifies GUI operations and CLI execution into a single action space, enabling batched actions per model turn.
contrib.zh: 将 GUI 操作与 CLI 执行统一到单一动作空间，支持在单个模型回合内生成批量动作。

contrib.en: Introduces an AutoResearch-style data flywheel where agents construct tasks, diagnose failures, and plan iterations.
contrib.zh: 引入 AutoResearch 风格的数据飞轮，由智能体构建任务、诊断失败并规划后续迭代。

contrib.en: Applies online reinforcement learning to trajectories beyond 100 turns using over 10,000 concurrent environments for rollout.
contrib.zh: 应用在线强化学习处理超过 100 轮次的轨迹，并利用 10,000 多个并发环境加速采样。

contrib.en: Adds a lightweight harness layer for proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer.
contrib.zh: 增加轻量级 harness 层，支持跨移动端和电脑的主动服务启动与有状态工作流。

contrib.en: Achieves state-of-the-art mobile-use results and competitive computer-use and browser-use performance against frontier models.
contrib.zh: 在移动端使用基准上取得最优结果，并在电脑使用与浏览器使用任务上达到与前沿模型相当的竞争力。

limits.en: Computer-use and web evaluations rely on sandbox environments rather than fully real-device deployment.
limits.zh: 电脑使用与网页评估依赖沙盒环境，而非完全真实设备部署。

limits.en: OSWorld-v2 performance remains partial-progress at 40.0%, indicating multi-step desktop tasks are not fully solved.
limits.zh: OSWorld-v2 上的表现仅为 40.0% 的部分进度，表明多步骤桌面任务尚未完全解决。

limits.en: Online RL's 100-turn trajectory support may not generalize to longer or more open-ended real-world workflows.
limits.zh: 在线强化学习对 100 轮次轨迹的支持可能无法泛化到更长或更开放的真实世界工作流。

limits.en: Proactive service initiation and stateful workflows are only demonstrated through a lightweight harness layer, not native platform integration.
limits.zh: 主动服务启动与有状态工作流仅通过轻量级 harness 层得到验证，尚未实现原生平台集成。

limits.en: Real-device runtime is limited to mobile; computer-use and web coverage lacks equivalent large-scale real-device validation.
limits.zh: 真实设备运行时仅限于移动端；电脑使用与网页覆盖缺乏同等规模的真实设备验证。
